description: Fetch a single post by id, including per-profile delivery status, the live URL of each published copy, and the error for any profile that failed.

id.description: The Database ObjectId of the post.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: get_post
